review_notes: I read the whole file and the supporting lemmas in Definitions: evalₐ_stabAut, evalₐ_mapₐ, levelMapₐ_mk and semilocalComponent. I compared the inline `hcomp`/`hsmul` blocks with the later lemmas `evalₐ_component` and `evalₐ_component_selfSmul`. I also compared the two `levelMapₐ`/`congrArg` transport blocks. I did not run Lean. The proposed rewrites are sketches that were never compiled. The unification of `g • x` with `stabAut … x` relies on the `rfl` already used at line 139–140. The other repeated fragment, the three lines deriving `Q.IsPrime`/`Q.LiesOver` before `exists_smul_eq_of_liesOver` (lines 281–283 and 359–361), is too small to count under the rubric, so I did not report it.

findings.problem: The same reasoning is carried out inline four times: unfold `semilocalComponent`, push `evalₐ` through `mapₐ`, rewrite the representative, and close with `levelMapₐ_mk`/`rfl`. `semilocalComponent_selfSmul` redoes it for `hcomp` (lines 133–136), for `hsmul` and again in its final `rw` (lines 137–146). `evalₐ_invariantsCompletionHom` redoes it at lines 250–251. The file later proves exactly these facts as `evalₐ_component` (lines 329–336) and `evalₐ_component_selfSmul` (lines 311–325), but only after the earlier proofs, so the earlier proofs cannot use them. `evalₐ_component_selfSmul` also re-proves `evalₐ_component` instead of calling it with the representative `g • z`.
findings.proposed_change:
Move `evalₐ_component` to just before `semilocalComponent_selfSmul` (its hypotheses are unchanged, and it needs only `semilocalComponent`, `evalₐ_mapₐ` and `levelMapₐ_mk`). Move `evalₐ_component_selfSmul` after it and prove it from `evalₐ_component`. Its proof is `evalₐ_component A B 𝔭 hQ (stabAut … x) n (g • z) (by rw [evalₐ_stabAut A B G _ _ n x z hz]; rfl)`. Then:

* `semilocalComponent_selfSmul`: `ext_evalₐ fun n => ?_`, obtain `z`. Rewrite `g • x` as `stabAut … x` by `rfl` (as at lines 139–140). Then `rw [evalₐ_component_selfSmul A B G 𝔭 g _ x n z hz]; exact (evalₐ_transportOf A B G g (le_refl _) n _ z (evalₐ_component A B 𝔭 hQ x n z hz).symm).symm`. This removes `hcomp`, `hsmul` and the closing `rw … rfl`.
* `evalₐ_invariantsCompletionHom`: keep `hbc`, then `exact evalₐ_component A B 𝔭 (mem_index_self A B G 𝔭 𝔓).2 _ n _ hbc.symm` in place of lines 250–251.

The omitted instance arguments are the same as in the existing lemmas, so no new hypotheses are needed.
findings.benefit: The "evaluate a semilocal component on a representative" argument is stated and proved once. It no longer sits in three of the four proofs that use it (the fourth already calls it), and the helper lemmas come before their first use. Later changes to `semilocalComponent` or `evalₐ_mapₐ` then need edits in one place instead of four.

findings.problem: Both proofs push an equality of residues modulo `J ^ n` through `levelMapₐ` for the algebra map of `g`, rewrite with `levelMapₐ_mk` twice, and restate the result by `:= h2`. They do this to turn `mk (J^n) a = mk (J^n) b` into `mk (Q^n) (g • a) = mk (Q^n) (g • b)`. The first occurrence is `transportOf_eq_of_fixed` (lines 111–115). The second is the `h2`/`h3` block in `exists_invariantsCompletionHom_eq` (lines 391–396). Each copy spells out the `toAlgEquiv` cast, the `map_toAlgEquiv_le_of_smul_le` proof and the `show`-style restatement.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma in the Transport section, after `map_toAlgEquiv_le_of_smul_le`:

`theorem mk_smul_eq_of_smul_le (g : G) {J Q : Ideal B} (h : g • J ≤ Q) (n : ℕ) {a b : B} (hab : Ideal.Quotient.mk (J ^ n) a = Ideal.Quotient.mk (J ^ n) b) : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Q ^ n) (g • a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Q ^ n) (g • b)`.

Proof: `have := congrArg (levelMapₐ J Q (MulSemiringAction.toAlgEquiv A B g : B →ₐ[A] B) (map_toAlgEquiv_le_of_smul_le A B G g h) n) hab; rwa [levelMapₐ_mk, levelMapₐ_mk] at this`, with the final `rfl`-style unfolding of `toAlgEquiv_apply` as in the current `h3` lines.

Then in `transportOf_eq_of_fixed`: `have h3 := mk_smul_eq_of_smul_le A B G g' hg'.le n h1`, followed by the existing `rwa [← mul_smul, mul_inv_cancel_left] at h3`.

In `exists_invariantsCompletionHom_eq`: `have h3 := mk_smul_eq_of_smul_le A B G g (smul_inv_smul g (P : Ideal B)).le n h1`.
findings.benefit: The two long proofs lose about five lines each of bookkeeping and unification. The lemma states the "smul respects residues" fact once, next to `evalₐ_transportOf`. A reader of the large existence proof can see which steps are mathematical, namely the stabiliser argument and the choice of coset representatives.
